info.syllabusName: Tiếng Anh Thương mại - Cấp 2_Business English – Level 2
info.timeAllocation:
Hours Per Course: 20 sessions

1 session = 135 minutes
info.description:
This course is designed to help students further improve their ability to communicate in English in a wide range of business and business-related situations at upper intermediate level of English. It also helps students develop necessary knowledge and skills to succeed in business. In addition to the business-focused contents, the course is enhanced with supplementary activities corresponding to B2+ level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. In particular the course will help students:

* Communicate effectively in discussions, meetings, negotiations, socialization events

* acquire and effectively use professional skills including telephoning, presentations, correspondence exchange, decision making, and problem solving.

* enrich knowledge of business trends in the fast-changing world

* enhance students' employabilty
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Access the course website (https://fu-edunext.fpt.edu.vn/) for group discussions to contruct knowledge, for practicing and assessment
info.note:
1) On-going assessment

- Progress test: 02*15%: 30%

- Assignment: 02*10%: 20%

2) Final Examination (FE) 50%

3) Final Result 100%

4) Completion Criteria:

a) On-going assessment >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10

b) Each part of final exam must be >0.

- If FE < 4/10, student must take resit exam (all parts);

- If have a) but not b), student must take resit exam for the failed parts only

materials.author: Iwonna DubickaMarjorie RosenbergBob DignenMike HoganLizzie WrightwithMargaret O'KeeffeLewis LansfordRos Wright

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate knowledge of business vocabulary, terminology and concepts (of level B2+) in digital business, finance, investment, management, relocation, strategic alliances, and operations to convey messages clearly and effectively

Build awareness and identify business situations, including how to understand and communicate in different business contexts and working across cultures with authentic content at B2+ level from the Financial Times and other news sources

Apply the principles of effective business communication at B2+ level ( language skills, soft skills and business skills), including clarity, conciseness, and formality in various international business settings ; Demonstrate a professional attitude in all forms of business communication, showing respect, politeness, and consideration for others.
Demonstrate critical thinking skills to analyze business problems and scenarios critically
Write e-mails of proposal and business report summary
Be cooperative, supportive, and responsible in group work.
Apply the processes involved in financing, business change, market research, relocation, partnership, and decision-making that enhances employability

Identify key points, main ideas, supporting details, writer/ speaker's tone and attitude, recognize different communication styles used in diverse contexts about a variety of business-related topics of level B2+
